newsitem.title: UK: IPE changes rules for board membership.
newsitem.headline: IPE changes rules for board membership.

text.p: London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) said on Monday it had approved reforms to the structure of its board of directors.
The exchange said it aimed to devolve responsibility for daily supervision of the exchange to committees leaving the board to "a strategic, longer term view."
Eligibility for board membership would be restricted to company directors or those "respected for competence in their field of business," the IPE said.
Directors would be allowed to serve for no more than two consecutive three year terms.
Trade associate members as well as IPE floor members will be allowed to stand for the board in an effort to increase links with the physical industry.
The changes were adopted at an extraordinary general meeting on Friday.
